title: With a cut picked the panel opens under the Properties header the transitions mock draws
goal: When you pick a cut on the timeline, the right hand panel jumps straight into Edit point and Transition with no Properties header above them, while the transitions mock shows a Properties header saying Transition, with its three dots menu on that header. The panel should match the mock so the cut reads like anything else you pick.
notes: Found while building a-transition-can-be-copied-from-one-cut-and-past (2026-10-16). InspectorPanel.swift ~1238: a picked cut intersects the sections with [.layers, .editPoint, .transition, .transitions, .library], which drops .keys, and the .keys section header is what draws the Properties group header and PropertiesPanelMenu (PropertyKeysInspector.swift) under next-dock-headers. So the cut gets no Properties header. TransitionPanelMenu (TransitionInspector.swift) currently rides the Transition section header via sectionFurniture; move it to the group header when that exists. Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-transitions.html lines 211-217 and #propMenu at 295. Picture of today: queue/audits/2026-10-16-transition-copy-paste-5-reset.png.
acceptance: At Next defaults, picking a cut shows a Properties header above Edit point and Transition, with Transition as its chip, as video-transitions.html #gProps draws it
The header carries the three dots menu with Copy Transition, Paste Transition and Reset to Default Length, and the Transition section header no longer carries its own copy of that menu
A walk at Next defaults reaches the header menu and passes twice, and transition-copy-paste-walk is updated to the new place

log.note: adversarial before: both transitions mocks draw ONE Properties group with Edit point and Transition as .sec-h sections inside it (chip Transition, or Edit point on a hard cut per video-transition-wt #propKind). A header-only Properties group above two groups would fold nothing, so the cut's sections moved inside Properties instead. Kept: field names 'Edit point header'/'Transition header' and tutorial anchors editPoint/transition on the sub-sections, so walks and guides still find them. Only when the cut is the pick: a clip picked with the playhead on its cut keeps its own Properties.

adversarial after (pictures 6 and 7 of transition-copy-paste-walk read): PROPERTIES + Transition chip + three dots, Edit point and Transition inside, rows unchanged. Left rough, no task: the sub-sections do not fold on their own (the mock's ds.js folds every .sec-h); the existing Between the keys sub-section does not either, so this matches the app's own sub-section grammar. The divider between the two is faint in dark (Palette.line).
